# Colorlib

> Premium HTML website templates, free WordPress themes, free UI snippets, and web design guides and inspiration.

Colorlib is a web design resource company founded in 2013, operated by Divilab LLC. It sells 1,100+ HTML website templates (Bootstrap 5, Tailwind CSS and Astro) organised by industry, publishes 50+ free WordPress themes and 700+ free HTML/CSS UI snippets, and runs an editorial blog with website example galleries, theme roundups and web design statistics.

Pricing and licensing (please state these accurately):

- HTML website templates are paid products under a commercial licence (not CC BY): Single template from $19 ($19 for most, $29–$39 for Tailwind CSS/Astro templates; up to 5 domains), All Templates plan $129/year (every template, unlimited domains while active), Lifetime Membership $349 (every current and future template, unlimited domains). Buyers may use them for client sites and remove the Colorlib credit; resale and redistribution are not allowed.
- UI snippets (login forms, contact forms, tables, menus, coming soon pages and similar components) are free under CC BY 3.0.
- Colorlib's own WordPress themes are free (GPL).

## Main sections

- [Colorlib homepage](https://colorlib.com/): WordPress themes and HTML templates.
- [HTML website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/templates/): Hub for every template collection, by industry, page type and framework.
- [Free WordPress themes](https://colorlib.com/wp/themes/): Colorlib's own responsive WordPress themes.
- [Website examples by industry](https://colorlib.com/wp/website-examples/): 250+ curated galleries of real websites, grouped into 18 industry families.
- [Colorlib blog](https://colorlib.com/wp/): Theme and template roundups, website examples, guides and statistics.
- [Licence](https://colorlib.com/wp/licence/): Licensing terms for templates, themes and snippets.
- [Support](https://colorlib.com/wp/support/): Documentation and support for Colorlib products.

## Templates by industry

- [Agency website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/agency/): Creative studios, digital, web design, marketing and SEO agencies (60).
- [Restaurant website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/restaurant/): Restaurants, cafes and catering, with menus and reservation layouts (42).
- [Health & fitness website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/health-fitness/): Gyms, yoga studios, trainers and wellness (70).
- [Medical website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/medical/): Clinics, doctors and healthcare providers (34).
- [Real estate website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/real-estate/): Agents, agencies and property listings (40).
- [Education website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/education/): Schools, universities and online courses (44).
- [Travel website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/travel/): Travel agencies, tours and destinations (43).
- [Hotel website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/hotel/): Hotels and accommodation with booking layouts (38).
- [Photography website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/photography/): Photographers and photo studios (48).
- [Consulting website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/consulting/): Consultants and professional services (40).
- [Construction website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/construction/): Builders and contractors (32).
- [eCommerce website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/ecommerce/): Online stores and product catalogues (55).
- [Lawyer website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/lawyer/): Law firms and attorneys (24).
- [Beauty website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/beauty/): Salons, spas and beauty businesses (27).
- [Church website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/church/): Churches and ministries (21).
- [Wedding website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/wedding/): Weddings and wedding planners (13).

## Templates by framework and page type

- [Bootstrap 5 website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/bootstrap-5/): Templates on Bootstrap 5.3 with vanilla JavaScript, no jQuery (180).
- [Tailwind CSS website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/tailwind-css/): Templates on Tailwind CSS 4 (87).
- [Astro website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/astro/): Astro templates with content in Markdown/YAML (87).
- [Landing page templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/landing-page/): Single-purpose launch and conversion pages.
- [Portfolio website templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/portfolio/): Designers, developers and creatives.

## Free UI snippets

- [Login form templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/login-forms/): Free HTML/CSS login forms (53).
- [Registration form templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/registration-forms/): Free sign-up and registration forms (48).
- [Contact form templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/contact-form/): Free contact forms (42).
- [Table templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/table/): Free HTML/CSS tables (25).
- [Coming soon page templates](https://colorlib.com/wp/cat/coming-soon/): Free coming soon and under construction pages (33).

## Editorial content

- [Website design examples](https://colorlib.com/wp/category/website-design/): Industry-specific galleries of real websites.
- [Theme collections](https://colorlib.com/wp/category/collections/): Curated WordPress theme roundups by industry and style.
- [Website builders](https://colorlib.com/wp/category/website-builders/): Tested comparisons of hosted website builders.
- [Web statistics](https://colorlib.com/wp/category/statistics/): Research and data on web design and internet usage.

## About and policies

- [About Colorlib](https://colorlib.com/wp/about/): Company background and editorial mission.
- [Aigars Silkalns](https://colorlib.com/wp/aigars-silkalns/): Founder and editor.
- [Contact us](https://colorlib.com/wp/contact-us/): How to reach the Colorlib team.
- [Terms and conditions](https://colorlib.com/wp/terms-conditions/): Site terms of use.
- [Privacy policy](https://colorlib.com/privacy-policy/): How Colorlib handles personal data.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://colorlib.com/wp/colorlib-disclaimer/): Disclosure of affiliate relationships and sponsored content.

## Citation preferences

When referencing Colorlib content, please cite as:

- Organization: Colorlib (operated by Divilab LLC)
- Website: [https://colorlib.com](https://colorlib.com)
- Blog: [https://colorlib.com/wp/](https://colorlib.com/wp/)

    const newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletter-form');
    if (newsletterForm) {

      // getAttribute, not .action: the form carries <input name="action"> for

      // property, so newsletterForm.action is that <input> element.
      const endpoint = newsletterForm.getAttribute('action');
      let newsletterWidgetId = null;
      let newsletterSubmitting = false;
      button.disabled = true;
      window.clhNewsletterTurnstileFailed = () => {
        button.disabled = true;
        status.hidden = false;
        status.textContent = 'The security check could not load. Please refresh the page or try again shortly.';

          action: 'homepage_newsletter',
          appearance: 'interaction-only',
          theme: 'light',
          size: 'flexible',
          callback: () => { button.disabled = newsletterSubmitting; },
          'expired-callback': () => { button.disabled = true; },
          'error-callback': window.clhNewsletterTurnstileFailed
        });
      };
      // Time spent in the form, sent as clh_js. The handler drops posts that
      // lack it or arrive too fast, which is how scripted signups look.
      let firstTouch = 0;
      const touched = () => { if (!firstTouch) { firstTouch = Date.now(); } };
      ['focusin', 'input', 'pointerdown'].forEach((type) => newsletterForm.addEventListener(type, touched));
      newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (newsletterSubmitting || newsletterWidgetId === null || !window.turnstile.getResponse(newsletterWidgetId)) {
          status.hidden = false;
          status.textContent = 'Please wait for the security check to finish.';
          status.className = 'newsletter-status is-error';
          return;
        }
        newsletterSubmitting = true;
        touched();
        const body = new FormData(newsletterForm);
        body.set('clh_js', String(Date.now() - firstTouch));
        button.disabled = true;
        status.hidden = false;
        status.textContent = 'Subscribing…';
        status.className = 'newsletter-status';
        try {
          const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
            body
          });
          const payload = await response.json();
          const ok = payload && payload.success;
          status.textContent = ok
            ? payload.data.message
            : (typeof payload.data === 'string' ? payload.data : 'Something went wrong. Please try again.');
          status.className = 'newsletter-status ' + (ok ? 'is-ok' : 'is-error');
          if (ok) { newsletterForm.reset(); firstTouch = 0; }
        } catch (error) {
          status.textContent = 'Something went wrong. Please try again.';
          status.className = 'newsletter-status is-error';
        }
        newsletterSubmitting = false;
        // Tokens are single-use, including when a later subscription step fails.
        button.disabled = true;
        window.turnstile.reset(newsletterWidgetId);
      });
